hero.title: WAKE UP
hero.subtitle: From unconscious living to disciplined, Christ-centered leadership.
hero.scripture: "Awake, O sleeper, and rise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you."

sections.heading: This is for the man who knows he’s capable of more.

items.text: You lack discipline in key areas of your life
You know you’re meant to lead but don’t feel aligned
You struggle with habits, direction, or identity
You want structure, clarity, and purpose

sections.closing:
You don’t need more information.
You need transformation.
